parameters.query:
-- W24 step 1: active leads = has a phone, inside retention, not opted out, not already suppressed.
-- $1 mode ('api' returns the E.164 number; 'csv' returns hashes only: data minimisation)
-- $2 include_legacy (brand_id null rows = legacy B2B product, NH-14), $3 test_mode (is_synthetic rows only)
with n as (
  select l.id, l.broker_id, l.brand_id, regexp_replace(l.phone, '\D', '', 'g') as d
  from public.leads l
  where l.phone is not null
    and (l.brand_id is not null or $2::boolean)
    and coalesce(l.is_synthetic, false) = $3::boolean
    and l.opted_out_at is null
    and (l.retention_delete_after is null or l.retention_delete_after > now())
), h as (
  select id, broker_id, brand_id, case when d like '00%' then substr(d, 3) when d like '0%' then '27' || substr(d, 2) else d end as e164_digits from n
)
select h.id as lead_id, h.broker_id, h.brand_id,
       case when $1 = 'api' then '+' || h.e164_digits end as phone_e164,
       public.smc_hash_contact('+' || h.e164_digits) as mobile_hash
from h
where not exists (
  select 1 from public.suppression s
  where s.mobile_hash = public.smc_hash_contact('+' || h.e164_digits)
);

-- Close gaps: any opted-out lead or objection whose hash is not on the list gets added.
with n as (
  select l.id, l.brand_id, l.opted_out_at, regexp_replace(l.phone, '\D', '', 'g') as d
  from public.leads l where l.phone is not null and l.opted_out_at is not null
), h as (
  select id, brand_id, opted_out_at, public.smc_hash_contact('+' || case when d like '00%' then substr(d, 3) when d like '0%' then '27' || substr(d, 2) else d end) as mobile_hash from n
), stop_gaps as (
  insert into public.suppression (mobile_hash, source, brand_id, lead_id, added_at)
  select h.mobile_hash, 'stop', h.brand_id, h.id, h.opted_out_at from h
  where not exists (select 1 from public.suppression s where s.mobile_hash = h.mobile_hash)
  on conflict (mobile_hash, source) do nothing
  returning 1
), objection_gaps as (
  -- NEEDS dsr_requests.mobile_hash (not in crm-gap A4; needs_human NH-CQ-W24-4)
  insert into public.suppression (mobile_hash, source, added_at)
  select d.mobile_hash, 'objection', coalesce(d.verified_at, d.received_at)
  from public.dsr_requests d
  where d.kind = 'object' and d.mobile_hash is not null
    and not exists (select 1 from public.suppression s where s.mobile_hash = d.mobile_hash)
  on conflict (mobile_hash, source) do nothing
  returning 1
)
select (select count(*) from stop_gaps)::int as stop_gaps_fixed,
       (select count(*) from objection_gaps)::int as objection_gaps_fixed;

with ms as (select (date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg') at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg') as t),
n as (
  select l.id, l.opted_out_at, regexp_replace(l.phone, '\D', '', 'g') as d from public.leads l where l.phone is not null
), h as (select id, opted_out_at, public.smc_hash_contact('+' || case when d like '00%' then substr(d, 3) when d like '0%' then '27' || substr(d, 2) else d end) as mobile_hash from n)
select
  (select count(*) from public.suppression)::int as suppression_rows,
  (select count(distinct mobile_hash) from public.suppression)::int as suppressed_people,
  (select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(source, c), '{}'::jsonb) from (select source, count(*) c from public.suppression group by source) x) as by_source,
  (select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(source, c), '{}'::jsonb) from (select s.source, count(*) c from public.suppression s, ms where s.added_at >= ms.t group by s.source) y) as added_this_month,
  -- Invariant: must be 0. A suppressed number with a lead still open for contact = W15 did not run.
  (select count(*) from h join public.suppression s on s.mobile_hash = h.mobile_hash where h.opted_out_at is null)::int as blocked_but_contactable;

-- C2 (monthly cleanse) + C3 (one list). amber until the IO signs in the console; red if the invariant failed.
update public.obligations
set last_done_at = now(),
    evidence_url = $1,
    status = case when $2::boolean then 'red' else 'amber' end,
    due_at = ((date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg') + interval '1 month' + interval '6 hours') at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')
where code in ('C2', 'C3')
returning code, status, due_at;

nodes.notes: W22 input: { kind: 'w24_evidence_ready', to: ['jonathan'], severity: red ? 'red' : 'info', deep_link: console Compliance tile }

parameters.query:
update public.obligations
set status = case when (now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date - date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date >= 3 then 'red' else 'amber' end
where code = 'C2'
returning code, status;

-- Runs daily. Retry from day 2 (day 1 belongs to the monthly trigger). No C2 row = register not seeded.
with ms as (select (date_trunc('month', now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg') at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg') as t),
d as (select extract(day from now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::int as dom)
select
  coalesce((select o.last_done_at is null or o.last_done_at < ms.t from public.obligations o where o.code = 'C2'), true) as cleanse_missing,
  exists (select 1 from public.obligations o where o.code = 'C2') as register_seeded,
  d.dom - 1 as days_since_due
from ms, d;

-- IO / PAIA / NCC renewal / breach drill. Reminders at 60, 30, 7, 1, 0 days; overdue or undated rows nag on Mondays.
with today as (select (now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date as d)
select o.code, o.description, o.owner, o.due_at,
       (o.due_at at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date - today.d as days_left,
       case when o.due_at is null then 'undated' when o.due_at < now() then 'overdue' else 'upcoming' end as state
from public.obligations o, today
where o.code in ('C1', 'P4', 'P5', 'P14')
  and (
    ((o.due_at at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date - today.d) in (60, 30, 7, 1, 0)
    or ((o.due_at is null or o.due_at < now()) and extract(isodow from today.d) = 1)
  );

nodes.name: Send renewal reminders (W22)
nodes.notes: W22 input: one item per obligation { kind: 'w24_reminder', to: ['jonathan','compliance-qa'], code, days_left, state }. W22 dedupes on code+days_left.
